problem.title: Sleep Session Grouping by Gap
problem.prompt: A sleep tracking app records heartbeat readings throughout the night. To analyze sleep sessions, you need to group consecutive readings into sessions separated by gaps of 10 minutes or more (indicating the user woke up or the device disconnected). Write a query that assigns a unique session identifier to each group of readings and returns summary statistics per session. For each user and session, calculate the session start time (`session_start`), session end time (`session_end`), total number of readings (`reading_count`), and average heart rate (`avg_heart_rate` rounded to 1 decimal). A new session begins when either this is the user's first reading OR more than 10 minutes have elapsed since their previous reading. Order results by `user_id`, then `session_start`.
problem.schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE heartbeat_readings (reading_id INT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT NOT NULL, recorded_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, heart_rate INT NOT NULL);

composite_moves: CTE1: LAG(recorded_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY recorded_at) to get previous_ts
CTE1: CASE WHEN previous_ts IS NULL OR recorded_at - previous_ts > INTERVAL '10 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as new_session_flag
CTE2: SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY recorded_at ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as session_id
GROUP BY user_id, session_id to compute MIN(recorded_at), MAX(recorded_at), COUNT(*), ROUND(AVG(heart_rate), 1)

hints: You'll need to identify where session boundaries occur by looking at the time gap between consecutive readings for each user.
Use LAG to get the previous reading's timestamp for each user, then flag rows where the gap exceeds 10 minutes or it's the user's first reading.
Once you have session boundary flags, use a running SUM of those flags as a session identifier, then GROUP BY user and session to compute the aggregate statistics.
problem.answer_key:
WITH gaps AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    recorded_at,
    heart_rate,
    LAG(recorded_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY recorded_at) AS previous_ts
  FROM heartbeat_readings
),
session_flags AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    recorded_at,
    heart_rate,
    CASE
      WHEN previous_ts IS NULL OR recorded_at - previous_ts > INTERVAL '10 minutes'
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS new_session_flag
  FROM gaps
),
session_ids AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    recorded_at,
    heart_rate,
    SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (
      PARTITION BY user_id
      ORDER BY recorded_at
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS session_id
  FROM session_flags
)
SELECT
  user_id,
  MIN(recorded_at) AS session_start,
  MAX(recorded_at) AS session_end,
  COUNT(*) AS reading_count,
  ROUND(AVG(heart_rate), 1) AS avg_heart_rate
FROM session_ids
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id, session_start;

_meta.scenario: a sleep tracking app tracking sleep score and goal achievement

WITH add_prev_time AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(recorded_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY recorded_at) AS prev_time
    FROM heartbeat_readings
),
flag_new_session AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN prev_time IS NULL OR recorded_at - prev_time > INTERVAL '10 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
    FROM add_prev_time
),
add_session_id AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY recorded_at) AS session_id
    FROM flag_new_session
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    MIN(recorded_at) AS session_start,
    MAX(recorded_at) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS reading_count,
    ROUND(AVG(heart_rate), 1) AS avg_heart_rate
FROM add_session_id
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id, session_start
